## Abstract

::: {.abstract}
Infectious disease models turn late, incomplete surveillance data into
estimates, forecasts and projections.
An AI agent is a language model that calls tools and loops until a check
passes.
We now use agents across our modelling work.
I will show where, using our model of the 2026 Ebola disease outbreak in
the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Agents read situation reports, implement and optimise models, build the
checks around them, and review code.
I will then cover the challenges.
Agents push towards complex code that is hard to review, and retrospective
evaluations can leak.
Collaborating when agents write most of the code is also hard.
:::
